questions.stem: EINSTEIN's most FAMOUS equation E = mc² expresses:
questions.explanation: E = mc² — most famous equation in physics; expresses MASS-ENERGY EQUIVALENCE. Formulated by ALBERT EINSTEIN (1905) in his paper 'Does the inertia of a body depend upon its energy content?' — one of 4 papers in his 1905 'MIRACLE YEAR' (ANNUS MIRABILIS): (1) Photoelectric effect (Nobel 1921); (2) Brownian motion (proof of atoms); (3) Special Relativity (E = mc²); (4) PhD thesis. MEANING: (1) MASS + ENERGY are INTERCHANGEABLE forms of the same thing. (2) c² = (3 × 10⁸)² = 9 × 10¹⁶ m²/s² — IMMENSE factor. (3) Tiny mass → HUGE energy. (4) 1 GRAM of mass = 9 × 10¹³ J = 25 million kWh = enough for a small town for year. PRACTICAL CONSEQUENCES: (1) NUCLEAR FISSION — splitting heavy nuclei (U-235, Pu-239) releases energy because fragments have slightly less total mass than original (mass defect). 1 kg U-235 fission releases ~80 TJ (enough for ~30,000 homes for a year). (2) NUCLEAR FUSION — fusing light nuclei (H → He in stars) releases MUCH more energy per kg. The SUN converts ~4 million TONNES of mass to energy PER SECOND via p-p chain (solar output 3.8 × 10²⁶ W). (3) ANTIMATTER annihilation — 1 g each of matter + antimatter = 180 TJ (~ 40 kilotons of TNT). Most efficient energy conversion. (4) EXPLAINS why rest mass of atoms < sum of constituent nucleon masses (mass defect = binding energy). SPECIAL RELATIVITY — Einstein's 1905 theory. 2 POSTULATES: (1) Laws of physics SAME in all INERTIAL reference frames. (2) SPEED OF LIGHT in vacuum is SAME for ALL observers, regardless of motion of source or observer. CONSEQUENCES (all confirmed experimentally): (1) TIME DILATION — moving clocks tick SLOWER. Moving at 0.99c, time passes ~1/7. Twin paradox — 1 twin stays, 1 travels near-c returns younger. Cosmic ray muons' survival disproportionately long = time dilation in action. GPS satellites corrected for both Special + General Relativity effects. (2) LENGTH CONTRACTION — moving objects appear shorter along motion axis. (3) SIMULTANEITY is RELATIVE — events simultaneous in one frame not in another. (4) MASS INCREASE with velocity — relativistic mass (m = m₀/√(1-v²/c²)); at c, mass → infinity (hence c is speed limit). (5) MASS-ENERGY EQUIVALENCE (E² = (mc²)² + (pc)²; E = mc² when p=0 for rest). GENERAL RELATIVITY (1915) — gravity = spacetime curvature. Predictions: perihelion of Mercury, gravitational lensing (Eddington 1919), gravitational waves (LIGO 2015), black holes (M87* 2019), expanding universe (Hubble 1929), GPS corrections (38 µs/day), frame-dragging (Gravity Probe B). QUANTUM MECHANICS (1900-30s) + GENERAL RELATIVITY are two PILLARS of modern physics — both WELL-TESTED but INCOMPATIBLE at extreme conditions (Planck scales, singularities). Quest for QUANTUM GRAVITY / THEORY OF EVERYTHING (TOE): string theory, loop quantum gravity, causal dynamical triangulation — no winner yet. EINSTEIN's LIFE: Born Ulm Germany 1879; patent clerk Bern 1902-09; Zurich + Berlin professor; NOBEL 1921 (photoelectric effect, not relativity — too controversial at time); emigrated to USA 1933 (Nazi persecution — Einstein was Jewish); Princeton professor till 1955 death (age 76). Advocated nuclear weapons vs Nazis (Einstein-Szilard letter 1939 to FDR → Manhattan Project); later peace activist. Most famous image: tongue out (1951 birthday photo by Arthur Sasse). small mass can convert to HUGE energy (c² = 9 × 10¹⁶); basis of nuclear power + bombs + stars' energy.

questions.stem: The PHOTOELECTRIC EFFECT, explained by Einstein (Nobel 1921), demonstrated that LIGHT is:

options.option_text: PARTICLE-LIKE (as PHOTONS with energy E = hf) in addition to wave behaviour; foundational for QUANTUM mechanics + 'wave-particle duality'

questions.explanation: PHOTOELECTRIC EFFECT — when LIGHT hits a metal surface, it can EJECT ELECTRONS. Observed 1887 by HEINRICH HERTZ; quantitative study by PHILIPP LENARD (Nobel 1905). PUZZLE: classical wave theory of light PREDICTED: (a) any light frequency should eject electrons (intensity matters); (b) KE of ejected electrons should depend on INTENSITY. OBSERVATION: (a) BELOW a THRESHOLD FREQUENCY, NO electrons ejected regardless of intensity. (b) ABOVE threshold, electron KE depends on FREQUENCY (NOT intensity); intensity only affects NUMBER of electrons. (c) Emission is INSTANTANEOUS even for weak light. EINSTEIN's EXPLANATION (1905): LIGHT consists of DISCRETE PACKETS / QUANTA called PHOTONS; each photon has ENERGY E = hf (h = Planck constant, f = frequency). Light is 'PARTICLE-LIKE' + electron absorbs ONE photon at a time. If E_photon > WORK FUNCTION (φ — minimum energy to free electron from metal) → electron ejected with KE = hf - φ. Threshold frequency f₀ = φ/h. Nobel Prize 1921 for this (not relativity!). SIGNIFICANCE: (1) Cemented QUANTIZATION of light energy (extended Planck's 1900 blackbody quantization of thermal radiation). (2) Start of QUANTUM MECHANICS. (3) WAVE-PARTICLE DUALITY — light is BOTH wave + particle depending on experiment. Later extended to matter (DE BROGLIE 1924 — matter waves; confirmed by Davisson-Germer 1927 electron diffraction). (4) Technology — solar cells, photomultiplier tubes, photodetectors, digital cameras. QUANTUM MECHANICS — theory of atoms + molecules + subatomic particles. KEY DEVELOPMENTS: (1) PLANCK 1900 — blackbody radiation; energy quantized E = hf. Nobel 1918. (2) EINSTEIN 1905 — photoelectric effect. (3) RUTHERFORD 1911 — gold foil experiment → nuclear atom (alpha scattering; most atom empty space with dense nucleus). (4) BOHR 1913 — H atom model; electrons in quantized orbits; emit/absorb photons when jumping levels. Nobel 1922. (5) DE BROGLIE 1924 — matter waves; λ = h/p; Nobel 1929. (6) HEISENBERG 1925 — matrix mechanics; UNCERTAINTY PRINCIPLE (1927) — Δx·Δp ≥ ℏ/2; can't know position + momentum precisely simultaneously. Nobel 1932. (7) SCHRÖDINGER 1926 — WAVE equation; wavefunctions; probability amplitudes. Schrödinger's cat thought experiment (1935). Nobel 1933. (8) DIRAC 1928 — relativistic QM; predicted ANTIMATTER (positron discovered 1932); Dirac equation. Nobel 1933. (9) PAULI EXCLUSION PRINCIPLE (1925) — 2 electrons can't occupy same quantum state (key for atomic structure + periodic table). Nobel 1945. (10) BORN 1926 — probabilistic interpretation of wavefunction (Copenhagen interpretation). Nobel 1954. (11) FEYNMAN + SCHWINGER + TOMONAGA — Quantum Electrodynamics (QED, 1940s-50s). Nobel 1965. (12) WEINBERG + SALAM + GLASHOW — Electroweak unification (Nobel 1979). (13) GELL-MANN — quarks, Standard Model (1964; Nobel 1969). (14) Higgs — Higgs mechanism (1964; Nobel 2013 with Englert after Higgs boson discovery CERN 2012). STANDARD MODEL of particle physics — 17 fundamental particles: 6 QUARKS (up, down, charm, strange, top, bottom) + 6 LEPTONS (electron, muon, tau + 3 neutrinos) + 4 FORCE CARRIERS (photon, W + Z bosons, gluon) + HIGGS boson (mass-giving). QUANTUM COMPUTING — based on superposition + entanglement; IBM Condor 1,121 qubits 2023; Google Sycamore supremacy 2019. POTENTIAL TRANSFORMATIONAL for crypto + drug discovery + materials.

questions.stem: The NUCLEUS of an ATOM was DISCOVERED by:
questions.explanation: ERNEST RUTHERFORD (1871-1937, New Zealand-born British) — 'FATHER OF NUCLEAR PHYSICS'. Won NOBEL PRIZE in CHEMISTRY 1908 (not Physics!) for INVESTIGATIONS INTO DISINTEGRATION OF ELEMENTS + chemistry of radioactive substances. Famously quipped about getting a chemistry Nobel — 'I have dealt with many different transformations with various time-periods, but the QUICKEST transformation I have met was my own, from physicist to chemist!' GOLD FOIL EXPERIMENT (1909-11) — Rutherford + HANS GEIGER + ERNEST MARSDEN at Manchester. Shot ALPHA PARTICLES (He-4 nuclei; 2 protons + 2 neutrons) at a thin GOLD FOIL (~1 atom thick). EXPECTED (per J.J. Thomson's PLUM PUDDING atomic model — atom as diffuse positive matter with electrons embedded like raisins): alpha particles should pass through slightly deflected. OBSERVED: (1) MOST (99.9%+) passed STRAIGHT through. (2) SOME deflected at small angles. (3) A FEW (~1 in 8,000) deflected at LARGE angles (>90°). (4) SOME even BOUNCED BACK. Rutherford: 'It was almost as incredible as if you fired a 15-inch shell at a piece of tissue paper + it came back + hit you'. CONCLUSION — RUTHERFORD'S NUCLEAR MODEL (1911): (1) Most of atom is EMPTY SPACE (hence most alphas pass through). (2) Mass + POSITIVE charge concentrated in a TINY DENSE NUCLEUS at centre (<1/10,000 of atom's size). (3) ELECTRONS orbit around nucleus (like planets around sun). (4) Atom is ELECTRICALLY NEUTRAL overall. Later: nucleus contains PROTONS (discovered by Rutherford 1919 via alpha + N-14 → O-17 + proton) + NEUTRONS (discovered by JAMES CHADWICK 1932 via alpha + Be-9 → C-12 + neutron; Nobel 1935). ATOMIC STRUCTURE: (1) NUCLEUS — protons (positive) + neutrons (neutral); held together by STRONG NUCLEAR FORCE (overcomes proton-proton repulsion at short range 1-3 fm). NUCLEUS size ~10⁻¹⁵ m (1 fm = femtometre). Mass = 99.9% of atom. (2) ELECTRONS — orbit nucleus; negative charge; mass 1/1836 of proton. Atom size ~10⁻¹⁰ m (0.1 nm = 1 angstrom). Ratio atom/nucleus ~100,000 (if nucleus = 1 cm marble, atom = 1 km across). (3) Atom is mostly EMPTY SPACE. ATOMIC NUMBER Z = # protons = # electrons (uncharged atom); determines element identity. MASS NUMBER A = protons + neutrons. ISOTOPES = same Z, different A (different neutron counts). ATOMIC MODELS chronology: (1) DALTON 1808 — atoms indivisible billiard balls. (2) THOMSON 1897 — discovered electron (cathode rays); PLUM PUDDING model. (3) RUTHERFORD 1911 — nuclear model. (4) BOHR 1913 — ELECTRONS in QUANTIZED ORBITS. Emit/absorb light at specific frequencies (explains H spectrum). (5) SOMMERFELD 1916 — elliptical orbits + quantum numbers. (6) DE BROGLIE 1924 — electrons as waves. (7) SCHRÖDINGER 1926 — WAVE MECHANICS; electrons as PROBABILITY CLOUDS (orbitals); 4 quantum numbers (n, l, m_l, m_s). Current accepted model. RUTHERFORD's OTHER contributions: (1) Coined term 'alpha' + 'beta' decay. (2) First artificial NUCLEAR TRANSMUTATION (1919). (3) Predicted neutron (Chadwick's teacher). (4) McGill + Manchester + Cavendish Cambridge labs. Mentored Bohr + Chadwick + Soddy + Hahn + Oppenheimer + others. Died 1937 (Baron Rutherford of Nelson). Element 104 RUTHERFORDIUM (Rf) named after him. GOLD FOIL experiment with alpha particles; found most matter is empty space + dense positively-charged NUCLEUS at center.

questions.stem: The FIRST NUCLEAR REACTOR (CP-1, Chicago Pile-1) was built by:
questions.explanation: ENRICO FERMI (1901-54) — Italian-American physicist; 'ARCHITECT OF THE NUCLEAR AGE'. Nobel Physics 1938 for NEUTRON-INDUCED RADIOACTIVITY + discovery of trans-uranic elements. Emigrated to USA 1938 (his wife Jewish + rising Fascism). CHICAGO PILE-1 (CP-1) — 1st man-made self-sustaining NUCLEAR CHAIN REACTION achieved 2 DECEMBER 1942 (3:25 PM) beneath Stagg Field (disused squash court), University of Chicago. FERMI's team included Herbert Anderson + Walter Zinn + Leo Szilard + Eugene Wigner + many others. DESIGN: 5.6-metre-wide pile of URANIUM OXIDE + URANIUM METAL slugs embedded in 385 TONS of GRAPHITE BLOCKS (graphite = moderator, slows neutrons). CADMIUM CONTROL RODS regulated reaction. Operated briefly (0.5 W power) to demonstrate criticality; shut down safely after 28 min. CHAIN REACTION: (1) U-235 nucleus absorbs neutron → splits into lighter nuclei (Ba + Kr + etc.) + releases 2-3 neutrons + energy; (2) those neutrons trigger more fissions → chain reaction. If each fission causes on average ≥1 more fission = 'critical mass' sustained. At >1 = supercritical (bomb). U-235 has ~0.7% abundance in natural uranium; U-238 99.3% (doesn't easily fission but absorbs neutrons → Pu-239 for bombs). MANHATTAN PROJECT (1942-46) — US government secret program to build atomic bomb before Nazis. HEAD: Major General LESLIE GROVES (military) + J. ROBERT OPPENHEIMER (scientific director at Los Alamos). 130,000+ workers; ~$2B (~$30B today). Key sites: Los Alamos (NM, weapon design), Oak Ridge (TN, U-235 enrichment), Hanford (WA, plutonium production), Chicago Metallurgical Lab, Trinity Site (NM). FIRST NUCLEAR TEST — TRINITY — 16 JULY 1945 at Alamogordo NM; plutonium implosion device; 20 kilotons yield; OPPENHEIMER quoted Bhagavad Gita: 'NOW I AM BECOME DEATH, DESTROYER OF WORLDS' (actually uttered in a 1965 TV interview; contemporaneous was 'it worked'). NUCLEAR BOMBS dropped on Japan: (1) 6 AUGUST 1945 — 'LITTLE BOY' (U-235 gun-type) on HIROSHIMA; 15 kilotons; ~140,000 dead by year end. (2) 9 AUGUST 1945 — 'FAT MAN' (Pu-239 implosion) on NAGASAKI; 21 kt; ~70,000 dead. Japan surrendered 15 Aug (VJ Day 2 Sep 1945). ONLY 2 NUCLEAR WEAPONS ever used in warfare. AFTERMATH: (1) OPPENHEIMER turned against H-BOMB (fusion weapon); security clearance revoked 1954 (restored posthumously 2022). (2) COLD WAR nuclear arms race; USSR test 1949 (Joe-1); UK 1952; France 1960; China 1964; India 1974 (Smiling Buddha) + 1998 (Operation Shakti 5 tests); Pakistan 1998 (Chagai); N Korea 2006. (3) NON-PROLIFERATION TREATY (NPT) 1968 — 5 'nuclear weapon states' (P5) + others pledge non-proliferation. India + Pakistan + Israel NEVER signed; N Korea withdrew 2003. (4) NUCLEAR POWER — civilian commercialisation from 1956 (UK Calder Hall first commercial reactor). NUCLEAR TREATIES: NPT 1968; PTBT 1963; SALT I + II 1972 + 1979; START I + II + new START; CTBT 1996 (not in force; India + Pakistan + others haven't signed); NSG waiver India 2008; JCPOA Iran deal 2015 (Trump left 2018, now defunct). INDIA's NUCLEAR: 3-STAGE programme (Bhabha) — PHWR + FBR + Thorium reactors. ~7.5 GW nuclear capacity; 22 operational reactors; Kudankulam, Kaiga, Tarapur, Kakrapar, Narora, Rawatbhata, Kalpakkam. 2 December 1942 at University of Chicago; first self-sustaining nuclear chain reaction; Manhattan Project; Nobel 1938.

questions.stem: MARIE CURIE is the ONLY person to win Nobel Prizes in TWO DIFFERENT SCIENCES. Her prizes were in:
questions.explanation: MARIE SKŁODOWSKA-CURIE (7 Nov 1867 – 4 July 1934) — Polish-born French physicist + chemist. FIRST WOMAN to win NOBEL PRIZE + ONLY PERSON to win NOBEL in 2 DIFFERENT SCIENCES + FIRST PERSON + ONLY WOMAN to WIN 2 NOBELS. NOBEL 1: PHYSICS 1903 — with HENRI BECQUEREL + PIERRE CURIE (her husband) for discovery of RADIOACTIVITY. Becquerel discovered 1896 that uranium salts emit invisible rays (spontaneous radiation; called 'Becquerel rays' → 'radioactivity' coined by Marie 1898). Curies showed thorium is also radioactive; isolated 2 new elements. NOBEL 2: CHEMISTRY 1911 — for DISCOVERY + ISOLATION of RADIUM (Ra, atomic number 88) + POLONIUM (Po, 84; named after her native POLAND). Radium's 1 GRAM of pure Ra took 4 YEARS of painstaking processing from TONS of pitchblende ore (mostly uranium, trace radium). Worked in miserable shed lab. BACKGROUND: born Warsaw under Russian occupation; barred from higher education there (girls); went to Paris 1891 (Sorbonne); met Pierre Curie 1894; married 1895. ACHIEVEMENTS: (1) Coined 'radioactivity'. (2) Isolated 2 elements. (3) Research during WWI — mobile X-ray units ('petites Curies') to battlefields; trained 150 women operators; X-rayed 1 million+ wounded. (4) Paris + Warsaw Radium Institutes founded. (5) Father + mother + daughter + son-in-law all Nobel laureates — FAMILY of 5 Nobels! Daughter IRÈNE JOLIOT-CURIE shared 1935 Nobel Chemistry with husband FRÉDÉRIC JOLIOT — for ARTIFICIAL RADIOACTIVITY (induced radioactive isotopes). PIERRE died tragically 1906 (run over by horse-drawn wagon Paris). DEATH: 1934 from APLASTIC ANAEMIA due to long-term RADIATION exposure (her notebooks still radioactive today; kept in lead-lined box at Bibliothèque Nationale). Buried in PANTHEON Paris (first woman to be buried there on merit, 1995). Nickname: 'Madame Curie'; 'Brains are more valuable than beauty'. RADIOACTIVITY — phenomenon by which unstable atomic NUCLEI spontaneously EMIT radiation to achieve stability. 3 TYPES: (1) ALPHA (α) DECAY — helium-4 nucleus (2 protons + 2 neutrons) emitted; heavy nucleus → lighter + alpha. Stopped by paper. Examples: U-238 → Th-234 + α; Rn-222 decay. Highly ionising, damaging if inhaled. (2) BETA (β) DECAY — high-energy electron (β−) OR positron (β+) emitted from nucleus. β−: neutron → proton + e⁻ + antineutrino. β+: proton → neutron + e⁺ + neutrino. Penetrates skin; stopped by aluminium. Examples: C-14 → N-14 + e⁻ (used in carbon dating). (3) GAMMA (γ) — high-energy PHOTON (EM radiation); usually accompanies alpha or beta; nucleus de-excites. Most penetrating (needs lead / concrete). Gamma knife for medicine. HALF-LIFE — time for half of radioactive atoms to decay. Varies hugely: U-238 4.5 billion years; C-14 5,730 yr; Ra-226 1,600 yr; I-131 8 days; F-18 110 min (PET scan). APPLICATIONS: (1) MEDICAL — X-rays, CT, PET, radiotherapy (gamma knife, cobalt-60, cyberknife); nuclear medicine (Tc-99m 85% of scans). (2) CARBON DATING — C-14/C-12 ratio in organic material dates back 50,000 years (Nobel 1960 Libby). (3) Nuclear power. (4) Food irradiation. (5) Smoke detectors (Am-241). (6) Industrial gauging + welding inspection. (7) Radiodating (U-Pb ~billions of years). HEALTH HAZARDS: ionising radiation damages DNA + causes cancer. Units: Bq (activity = 1 decay/sec), Gy (absorbed dose J/kg), Sv (biological effect). Background = 2-3 mSv/yr; CT scan ~10 mSv; chest X-ray 0.1 mSv; lethal whole-body acute = 4-6 Sv. for RADIOACTIVITY (with Henri Becquerel + Pierre Curie) + isolation of RADIUM + POLONIUM.

questions.stem: The HIGGS BOSON, the 'GOD PARTICLE', was experimentally CONFIRMED at:
questions.explanation: HIGGS BOSON — fundamental particle in Standard Model of particle physics; popularly called 'GOD PARTICLE' (term from Leon Lederman's 1993 book title; not liked by physicists as it misleads). PROPOSED 1964 theoretically by 6 physicists in 3 separate papers (PRL 1964): (1) PETER HIGGS (UK) — 'Broken Symmetries + Masses of Gauge Bosons'. (2) FRANÇOIS ENGLERT + ROBERT BROUT (Belgium). (3) Gerald Guralnik + C.R. Hagen + Tom Kibble (UK-USA). All independently. EXPLAINED the 'HIGGS MECHANISM' — how FUNDAMENTAL PARTICLES acquire MASS via interaction with an all-pervading QUANTUM FIELD called the HIGGS FIELD. Without Higgs field, fundamental particles would be massless (like photons) + universe couldn't form atoms/matter. Particles interacting more strongly with field = more MASSIVE (top quark heaviest; electron light; photon massless since doesn't interact). KEY PROPERTY: unlike other known fields (EM, gravity, etc.), Higgs field has NON-ZERO VALUE even in vacuum ('vacuum expectation value' = 246 GeV). Excitations of this field = Higgs boson. DISCOVERY: 4 JULY 2012 announced at CERN (European Organisation for Nuclear Research, Geneva, founded 1954). LARGE HADRON COLLIDER (LHC) — 27-km circular particle accelerator underground on France-Switzerland border; world's LARGEST + most powerful; proton-proton collisions at 13 TeV. TWO INDEPENDENT EXPERIMENTS: (1) ATLAS + (2) CMS (Compact Muon Solenoid) — both observed particle consistent with Higgs at mass ~125 GeV (~133× proton mass). Peter Higgs present in room emotional tears; said 'it's incredible that this has happened in my lifetime'. NOBEL PRIZE in PHYSICS 2013 → ENGLERT + HIGGS (Brout had died 2011; Nobel rules no posthumous). Indian contribution: SATYENDRA NATH BOSE (1894-1974) derived statistics for BOSONS — particles with INTEGER spin that can occupy same quantum state. PHOTON, GLUON, W, Z, HIGGS are all BOSONS. FERMIONS = half-integer spin (electrons, quarks, leptons) — obey PAULI EXCLUSION. BOSON named after S.N. Bose — he worked with Einstein (Bose-Einstein statistics + Bose-Einstein condensate). TRAGEDY: Bose never won Nobel (his statistical work predated prize developments). Higgs boson DECAYS very fast (~10⁻²² s) to lighter particles — detected indirectly via decay products. STANDARD MODEL — 17 particles: (a) 6 QUARKS (up, down, charm, strange, top, bottom) + antiparticles — make up protons + neutrons + exotic hadrons. (b) 6 LEPTONS (electron, muon, tau + 3 neutrinos). (c) 4 FORCE-CARRIER BOSONS — photon (EM), gluon (strong, 8 types), W + Z (weak). (d) HIGGS (mass). NOT included in SM: GRAVITY (GR not unified with QM); DARK MATTER; DARK ENERGY. LHC OTHER achievements: (1) Top quark precision mass measurement. (2) Confirmed W boson. (3) No supersymmetric particles found (SUSY theory on hold). (4) Pentaquarks + tetraquarks discovered. (5) Quark-gluon plasma studies. FUTURE: LHC HL-LHC (High Luminosity upgrade 2029+). Proposed Future Circular Collider (FCC) at CERN = 100 km ring. China CEPC proposed. Muon colliders + linear colliders proposed. CERN members = ~23 European states; INDIA is ASSOCIATE MEMBER (since 2017). India contributed key components to CMS + ATLAS + TIFR / VECC / BARC / IIT scientists involved. CMS Higgs observation paper had 50+ Indian authors. INDIA at CERN is part of diplomatic + scientific strategy. via LARGE HADRON COLLIDER on 4 July 2012; gives other particles MASS via Higgs Mechanism; Higgs + Englert Nobel 2013.

questions.stem: The BIG BANG THEORY states that our UNIVERSE began:

options.option_text: ~13.8 BILLION YEARS AGO from an extremely hot, dense state

questions.explanation: BIG BANG THEORY — prevailing cosmological model of observable UNIVERSE's origin + evolution. Universe BEGAN from extremely HOT + DENSE + tiny state ~13.8 BILLION YEARS AGO (precisely 13.787 ± 0.020 Gyr per Planck 2018 data) + has been EXPANDING ever since. 'BIG BANG' term coined 1949 by FRED HOYLE (dismissively on BBC radio; he preferred steady-state theory) but stuck. THEORY DEVELOPMENT: (1) 1917 — EINSTEIN's General Relativity equations could describe expanding/contracting universe; he added COSMOLOGICAL CONSTANT to force static universe. Later called it 'biggest blunder'. (2) 1922 — ALEXANDER FRIEDMANN (Russian) derived expanding universe solutions from GR. (3) 1927 — GEORGES LEMAÎTRE (Belgian Catholic priest + physicist) proposed 'primeval atom' theory — first big bang idea. Published before Hubble's observation. (4) 1929 — EDWIN HUBBLE observed galaxies RECEDING with velocities proportional to distance (Hubble's Law, v = H₀·d; now known as Hubble-Lemaître Law); proved UNIVERSE is EXPANDING. (5) 1948 — GAMOW, ALPHER, HERMAN predicted the COSMIC MICROWAVE BACKGROUND (CMB) — residual heat from Big Bang should be detectable as ~5 K radiation. (6) 1964 — ARNO PENZIAS + ROBERT WILSON (Bell Labs) accidentally DISCOVERED CMB (2.7 K microwave background in all directions) — strong evidence for Big Bang. Nobel 1978. BIG BANG TIMELINE: (1) t=0 SINGULARITY (untreatable by current physics; needs quantum gravity). (2) 10⁻⁴³ s (Planck time) — earliest physics can speak. (3) 10⁻³⁶ to 10⁻³² s — INFLATION EPOCH (Guth 1980) — universe expanded 10²⁶ × in instant; smoothed + flat. (4) 10⁻¹² s — quark epoch. (5) 10⁻⁶ s — QUARKS combine into protons + neutrons (HADRON epoch). (6) 1 s — 3 BILLION K; neutrinos decouple. (7) 3 MIN — BIG BANG NUCLEOSYNTHESIS: protons + neutrons form LIGHT NUCLEI (75% H, 25% He, trace Li, D); universe cools to billion K. (8) 380,000 YR — RECOMBINATION: electrons + nuclei form ATOMS; universe becomes transparent → CMB photons escape (the 'photon decoupling'). (9) 100-200 MILLION YR — first stars form (Population III, huge, short-lived). (10) 1 BILLION YR — first galaxies + quasars. (11) 9 BILLION YR — Sun + Solar System form. (12) 10 BILLION YR (~4 BILLION YR ago) — Earth forms + life begins. (13) 13.8 BILLION YR — NOW. EVIDENCE for BIG BANG: (1) Hubble REDSHIFT — galaxies receding; redshift ∝ distance; expansion. (2) CMB — uniform 2.725 K microwave glow. Mapped in detail by COBE 1992, WMAP 2001, PLANCK 2009-18 satellites. Tiny anisotropies (~10⁻⁵) = seeds of galaxy formation. (3) ABUNDANCE of LIGHT ELEMENTS — ~75% H + 25% He + traces Li + D match big bang nucleosynthesis predictions. (4) Large-scale galaxy structure. (5) CMB spectrum = near-perfect blackbody. HOT TOPICS: (1) DARK MATTER (~27% of universe) — invisible mass; seen via gravity (galaxy rotation curves, CMB, lensing). Candidate: WIMPs, axions; not detected directly. (2) DARK ENERGY (~68%) — mysterious force driving ACCELERATING expansion (discovered 1998 via Type Ia supernovae; Nobel 2011 Perlmutter + Schmidt + Riess). Possibly EINSTEIN's cosmological constant reinstated. (3) ORDINARY MATTER only 5%. (4) HUBBLE TENSION — different H₀ measurements disagree (local supernovae ~73 vs CMB ~67 km/s/Mpc) — unresolved. (5) Multiverse, inflation details, quantum gravity, black holes. UNIVERSE may end in BIG FREEZE (heat death), BIG RIP, BIG CRUNCH — depends on dark energy evolution. OBSERVABLE UNIVERSE ~93 BILLION LY across (bigger than 13.8 Gly × c due to expansion). still EXPANDING (confirmed by Hubble 1929); CMB + galactic redshift + element abundances = pillars of evidence.

options.option_text: The MORE precisely POSITION of a particle is determined, the LESS precisely its MOMENTUM can be known (Δx·Δp ≥ ℏ/2); fundamental quantum limitation

questions.explanation: HEISENBERG's UNCERTAINTY PRINCIPLE (1927) — FUNDAMENTAL QUANTUM-mechanical LIMITATION: you CANNOT simultaneously know BOTH POSITION (x) + MOMENTUM (p = mass × velocity) of a particle with ARBITRARY PRECISION. FORMULATION: Δx · Δp ≥ ℏ/2, where ℏ = h/2π = 1.055 × 10⁻³⁴ J·s (reduced Planck constant). If position precisely known (Δx small), momentum UNCERTAIN (Δp large), + vice versa. NOT a measurement-LIMITATION but a fundamental feature of QUANTUM REALITY. Similar pair: energy-time (ΔE · Δt ≥ ℏ/2). PROPOSED by WERNER HEISENBERG (German, age 25) in 1927 paper 'Über den anschaulichen Inhalt der quantentheoretischen Kinematik + Mechanik'. Nobel 1932 (at 31). Part of the 'COPENHAGEN INTERPRETATION' of quantum mechanics (with Bohr + Born). IMPLICATIONS: (1) CLASSICAL determinism (Newton: know all positions+momenta → predict everything) is IMPOSSIBLE. (2) Electrons don't have fixed 'orbits' — only PROBABILITY clouds (orbitals). (3) VACUUM is 'quantum foam' — brief particle-antiparticle pairs appear + annihilate via energy-time uncertainty. (4) Tunnel effect — particle can penetrate barriers impossible classically (alpha decay, scanning tunneling microscope, transistors). (5) ZERO-POINT ENERGY — even at 0 K, particles have residual motion. (6) Atomic stability — why electrons don't spiral into nucleus (which classical physics predicted). Uncertainty stabilises atoms. (7) HUMAN limits on knowledge. EXAMPLE: electron in atom; if you try to know its position exactly (photon high-energy to 'see' it), photon kicks electron away (momentum uncertain). ANALOGIES: flashlight in dust-storm — beam disturbs what you're observing. NOT mere experimental difficulty; intrinsic to nature. RELATED QUANTUM CONCEPTS: (1) WAVE-PARTICLE DUALITY — light + electrons behave as both waves + particles (famous DOUBLE-SLIT experiment: interference patterns even when 1 electron at a time → 'particles interfere with themselves'). (2) SUPERPOSITION — particle in combination of states till measured; Schrödinger's cat (both alive + dead). (3) MEASUREMENT collapse — observation 'collapses' superposition. (4) ENTANGLEMENT — 2+ particles correlated; measuring one instantly affects other regardless of distance (Einstein called 'spooky action at a distance'; EPR paradox 1935; Bell's inequalities 1964; experimental verification by Aspect 1982 onwards; Nobel 2022 Aspect + Clauser + Zeilinger). Basis of QUANTUM COMPUTING + QUANTUM CRYPTOGRAPHY. QUANTUM COMPUTING — uses qubits (0, 1, or superposition); can solve certain problems (factoring, optimization, simulation) exponentially faster. IBM, Google, Microsoft, Amazon + startups. IBM CONDOR 1,121 qubits 2023; aim for ERROR-CORRECTED quantum computers by 2030s. INDIA's National Quantum Mission (2023, ₹6,000 crore) — 4 hubs: IISc + TIFR + IIT Madras + IIT Bombay. QUANTUM CRYPTOGRAPHY — QKD (Quantum Key Distribution) uses entanglement for provably secure comms. Chinese Micius satellite 2016 demonstrated space-based QKD. INDIA tested QKD ground-to-ground (ISRO + DRDO). HEISENBERG's OTHER contributions: (a) Matrix mechanics (first formulation of QM 1925, with Born + Jordan). (b) Heisenberg model of magnetism. (c) Nuclear physics (S-matrix). (d) Controversial role in Nazi Germany's uranium project during WWII (debate continues — did he try to build bomb or sabotage?). COPENHAGEN INTERPRETATION — standard; wave function is probability amplitude; measurement collapses; observer role central. COMPETING: Many-Worlds (Everett 1957), pilot wave (Bohm), QBism, GRW (objective collapse).

questions.stem: The FIRST NUCLEAR POWER PLANT in INDIA is:
questions.explanation: TARAPUR ATOMIC POWER STATION (TAPS) — INDIA's 1ST NUCLEAR POWER PLANT. LOCATION: Tarapur, Palghar district, Maharashtra (on Arabian Sea coast). OPERATED by NUCLEAR POWER CORPORATION of INDIA LIMITED (NPCIL, est 1987). UNITS 1 + 2: Boiling Water Reactors (BWR) — 160 MW each; commissioned 28 Oct 1969 as TAPS-1 + 2. Built via US-India tech transfer (GE designed); after 1974 Pokhran-I, USA cut fuel supply; France supplied till 1983; then Russia, China (for Chinese-made MOX pellets briefly). UNITS 3 + 4: Pressurised Heavy Water Reactors (PHWR) 540 MW each; commissioned 2005-06 — INDIA-built indigenously. Thus TAPS has 4 reactors; total 1,400 MW. One of oldest operational BWRs in world (60-year life expected). INDIAN NUCLEAR POWER PLANTS (2024): 22 OPERATIONAL REACTORS + more under construction. (1) TARAPUR (MH, 4 reactors, 1,400 MW). (2) RAWATBHATA (Rajasthan, 6 reactors, 1,180 MW — PHWRs + 1 under decommissioning). (3) MADRAS / KALPAKKAM (TN, 2 reactors, 440 MW + the PFBR Fast Breeder under commissioning Aug 2024; + under-construction BHAVINI). (4) NARORA (UP, 2 × 220 MW PHWR). (5) KAKRAPAR (Gujarat, 4 reactors, 1,340 MW; latest 700 MW PHWR commissioned 2023; indigenous). (6) KAIGA (Karnataka, 4 × 220 MW). (7) KUDANKULAM (TN, 2 × 1000 MW VVER Russian, operational; 4 more under construction; largest in India when done). Total INSTALLED nuclear capacity: ~7.5 GW (2024). AIM: 22.4 GW by 2031; 100 GW by 2047 (VisionViksit Bharat). 3-STAGE NUCLEAR PROGRAMME of INDIA — formulated by Dr HOMI BHABHA 1950s; India's unique path due to LOW URANIUM but ABUNDANT THORIUM reserves. (1) STAGE 1 — Pressurised Heavy Water Reactors (PHWR) using NATURAL URANIUM (U-235 0.7%); generates electricity + PRODUCES plutonium (Pu-239) as byproduct. Most current Indian reactors are PHWR type. Mature + deployed. (2) STAGE 2 — FAST BREEDER REACTORS (FBR) using Pu-239 fuel; BREED more fissile material than they consume (Pu-239 + Th-232 → U-233). PFBR (Prototype FBR, 500 MW, Kalpakkam) achieved first criticality + power generation AUG 2024 — historic milestone; 30+ years in making, led by BHAVINI + IGCAR. (3) STAGE 3 — THORIUM REACTORS using U-233 (bred from Th-232 in Stage 2). India has 25% of world's thorium — 2nd largest. Long-term self-sufficient nuclear energy. AHWR (Advanced Heavy Water Reactor, 300 MW Thorium-based) being designed at BARC; pilot coming. SMALL MODULAR REACTORS (SMR) — India announced 2024 Budget focus; 10 SMRs (100-300 MW each) planned; BSMR design by BARC 2027+. NUCLEAR ORGS: (1) DEPARTMENT of ATOMIC ENERGY (DAE, est 1954 by Bhabha; directly under PM) — policy. (2) ATOMIC ENERGY REGULATORY BOARD (AERB, 1983) — regulation. (3) NPCIL (1987) — operates. (4) BHAVINI — Bharatiya Nabhikiya Vidyut Nigam — fast breeder reactors. (5) BARC (Bhabha Atomic Research Centre, Trombay 1954) — R&D + nuclear reactors + radioisotopes. (6) IGCAR Kalpakkam — fast reactor research. (7) NFC Hyderabad — nuclear fuel. (8) UCIL Jaduguda — uranium mining. (9) IREL — rare earths. INDO-US NUCLEAR DEAL (2005-08) — 123 Agreement; NSG waiver Sep 2008; CIVIL nuclear trade opened for India despite NPT non-membership. Civil + military separation plan. India has AREVA/France + ROSATOM/Russia + Westinghouse/USA + Candu/Canada import agreements. Under Civil Liability for Nuclear Damage Act 2010 — operator liable (not supplier) — delays imports. POKHRAN-I 1974 + POKHRAN-II 1998 made India nuclear-armed (NOT NPT-signed). commissioned 1969 (units 1 + 2); India's first + oldest; boiling water reactors; USA tech-transfer.

questions.stem: The FOUR FUNDAMENTAL FORCES of NATURE are:

options.option_text: GRAVITY, ELECTROMAGNETISM, STRONG NUCLEAR (binds nuclei), WEAK NUCLEAR (beta decay); unified in Standard Model except gravity

questions.explanation: FUNDAMENTAL FORCES (INTERACTIONS) of NATURE — all natural phenomena reducible to 4: (1) STRONG NUCLEAR FORCE — STRONGEST; binds QUARKS into PROTONS + NEUTRONS (via GLUONS) + binds protons + neutrons into NUCLEI (via residual strong force / pions). Strength = 1 (reference); range ~1 femtometre (10⁻¹⁵ m) — very SHORT. Charge = 'color' (red, green, blue, anti-colors). Carrier: GLUON (massless, 8 types). Described by QCD (Quantum Chromodynamics). Most fundamental strong force — without it, no atomic nuclei could exist. (2) ELECTROMAGNETISM — 2nd strongest. Attracts/repels charged particles; basis of electricity + magnetism + LIGHT + chemistry (atomic bonding) + friction + elasticity + normal force + all non-nuclear/gravitational daily phenomena. Strength = 1/137 (fine structure constant); range = INFINITE. Charge: electric (positive + negative). Carrier: PHOTON (massless). Described by QED (Quantum Electrodynamics — Feynman-Schwinger-Tomonaga, Nobel 1965); beautiful theory matching experiment to 12 decimal places (most precisely tested theory ever). (3) WEAK NUCLEAR FORCE — 3rd strongest. RESPONSIBLE for BETA DECAY + radioactive decay + energy production in SUN (hydrogen fusion pp-chain involves weak interaction). Strength = 10⁻⁶ of strong; range ~10⁻¹⁸ m. Charge: 'weak isospin' + 'weak hypercharge'. Carriers: W⁺ + W⁻ + Z⁰ BOSONS (MASSIVE — ~80-91 GeV each; hence short range). Unified with EM into ELECTROWEAK theory by GLASHOW + SALAM + WEINBERG (Nobel 1979); UNIFIED at high energies (~100 GeV); separated at low energies due to Higgs mechanism (spontaneous symmetry breaking). (4) GRAVITY — WEAKEST by far. Strength = 10⁻³⁸ (compared to strong). Range = INFINITE. ATTRACTIVE ONLY (no repulsive gravity known — important). Acts on MASS (+ energy, per GR). Carrier: hypothetical GRAVITON (spin-2, massless; not experimentally detected; gravitational waves = classical manifestation). GENERAL RELATIVITY describes gravity as SPACETIME CURVATURE — not a force in usual QFT sense. UNIFYING gravity with other 3 = HOLY GRAIL of physics (string theory, loop quantum gravity, causal dynamical triangulation — no complete theory yet). DESPITE being weakest, gravity dominates astronomy because: (a) ALWAYS ATTRACTIVE; (b) EM cancels (charges balance); (c) range unlimited (strong + weak short-range); (d) accumulates to huge scales. HIERARCHY PROBLEM — why is gravity so weak compared to other forces? Active research. GRAND UNIFIED THEORIES (GUT) — attempt to unify strong + electromagnetic + weak at very high energies (~10¹⁶ GeV; proton decay predicted — not observed). SUPERSYMMETRY + STRING theories attempt full unification including gravity — not confirmed. FORCE UNIFICATIONS HISTORY: (1) Newton 1687 — terrestrial + celestial gravity unified. (2) Maxwell 1864 — electricity + magnetism unified as electromagnetism. (3) Glashow-Salam-Weinberg 1967-73 — weak + EM = electroweak (confirmed CERN 1983). (4) Proposed: strong + electroweak = GUT; GUT + gravity = TOE. Fundamental forces ACT at different scales: gravity dominates cosmos; EM dominates chemistry + biology + technology; strong + weak dominate nuclei. Dark energy (behind accelerating expansion) may be EINSTEIN's COSMOLOGICAL CONSTANT — nature of gravity at largest scales. OBSERVABLES: gravitational waves (LIGO 2015), Higgs boson (CERN 2012), black hole images (EHT 2019 M87*, 2022 Sgr A*), galactic + cosmic scale phenomena testing GR. Dark MATTER + energy (95% of universe) remain mysterious.
